title: Query Count
statement: Implement `solve(parents, strategy)`. `strategy` is `lazy`, `selectin`, or `join`. Lazy runs 1 plus `parents` statements. Selectin runs 2 when parents is positive and 1 when parents is 0. Join runs 1. Any other strategy returns `error`. Negative parents returns `error`.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Lazy loading a collection inside a loop is the N+1 query.

editorial: Lazy loading a collection inside a loop is the N+1 query. selectinload issues one follow-up query for the page. joinedload folds the children into the parent query, which is one statement and a different LIMIT story. The count is what you assert in a test so a later edit cannot bring the loop back quietly.
